rows.summary: Fast source and contract checks: build, unit tests, race, coverage and lint. No agent is spawned and no external backend is provisioned.
The librarystore npm backend driving the real npm CLI (npm pack, npm publish) against an httptest registry, and module sync regenerating a stale package lockfile.
codefly run drives a real pinned Redis agent through Load, Init and Start over gRPC, with the agent resolving a Nix runtime, against the in-process control plane.
Contract and client generation through the real proto companion image, including the solution SDK facade compiled from a buf-built descriptor set.
blockers: No CI job provisions the proto companion image, so no run has ever proved this row.

rows.summary: The MCP run_service, flow_status and stop_flow tools drive a real flow that starts a Postgres container and reports it running.
blockers: No CI job runs this gate, so the MCP lifecycle surface has no conformance evidence.

rows.summary: MCP agent_info and add_service against an agent downloaded from the real release registry and driven through its Create flow.
blockers: Needs outbound access to the release registry from the test process; no CI job runs this gate.

rows.summary: GitOps publication rendered, applied and reconciled by ArgoCD on a disposable k3d cluster, for the service, solution and fetch-remote shapes.
blockers: No CI job provisions k3d, so the only deployment row has never run outside a developer machine.
The cluster is created at k3d's default k3s image; qualification requires an explicitly pinned kubernetes version.

rows.summary: The native user-service manager installing, starting and uninstalling a real launchd service.
blockers: CI has no macOS runner, so every released darwin binary ships without lifecycle evidence.

rows.summary: Windows is not a release target: .goreleaser.yaml builds darwin and linux only, and no lifecycle path is exercised on Windows.
